title: Enterprise ML Platform
description: Enterprise ML Platform is a production-oriented Python framework for building, operating, and monitoring machine learning systems in enterprise environments. The repository provides end-to-end MLOps components for multi-source data ingestion, feature engineering, distributed model training, model registry workflows, deployment automation, observability, drift detection, alerting, and data quality management. It includes API services, command-line tooling, tests, Docker and Kubernetes assets, Terraform infrastructure templates, monitoring dashboards, and example pipelines for domains such as fraud detection, natural language processing, computer vision, and time series forecasting.
references: Ribeiro, Diogo. Enterprise ML Platform. GitHub repository. https://github.com/diogoribeiro7/enterprise-ml-platform
notes: Source code archive for the Enterprise ML Platform Python package and its examples, tests, deployment manifests, monitoring configuration, and infrastructure templates.
